probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __2000 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than __200__ nm.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, and zirconium tetrachloride.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __selected from the group consisting of__ polyethylenimine and polypropylenimine.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and __other__ anionic surfactants.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, __and__ zirconium tetrachloride.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium __, calcium, or zinc__ ions.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __nanoparticle has an average particle size of about 100 to 200 nm in diameter__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation selected from the group consisting of Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe __, Al, or combinations thereof__.

14) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle for delivery of an oil and gas chemical to a reservoir, said composition comprising a polyethylenimine of less than __2000 Da__ and a polyanion intimately associated with an oil and gas field chemical to form a polyelectrolyte complex, said complex having an average particle size of less than __200__ nm.

15) (Currently Amended) A composition for controlled release of an oil and gas field chemical comprising: a) a polyanion and a polyethylenimine of less than __2000 Da__ forming a polyelectrolyte complex; b) said polyelectrolyte complex intimately associated with an oil and gas chemical selected from the group consisting of a (a) a gel-forming or cross-linking agent, (b) a scale inhibitor, (c) a corrosion inhibitor, (d) an inhibitor of asphaltene or wax, (e) a hydrogen sulfide scavenger, (f) a hydrate inhibitor, (g) a breaking agent, and (h) a surfactant; and c) said polyelectrolyte complex having an average particle size less than __200__ nm.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that can be crosslinked with said composition__; and c) a fluid.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __or N,N-dimethylacrylamide__.

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is __selected from the group consisting of brine, seawater, or fresh water__.
